stories.title: Shoplifting in Flintshire rose 16% last year as offences fell across Wales
stories.summary: Shoplifting recorded in Flintshire rose by 16% last year, even as it fell across Wales and England, new figures show. North Wales Police recorded 1,054 shoplifting offences in the county in the year to March 2026, up from 909 the year before, according to Office for National Statistics (ONS) data published today. stories.title: Flintshire Council tax debt rising as authority lacks powerful sanctions

stories.title: Driver caught on phone in Flintshire had no licence, insurance or MOT
stories.summary: A van has been seized in Flintshire after its driver was spotted using a mobile phone at the wheel, with checks then finding he had no valid licence, insurance or MOT. stories.title: Drought status declared for North Wales after wildfires and record-low river flows
stories.summary: Drought has been declared across North Wales, including the river catchments covering Flintshire, after widespread wildfires, record-low river flows and weeks of hot, dry weather.
